name: KUEPER Power Generation Knowledge Contract

knowledgeDomains.title: Elektrische Energieerzeugung - arbeitsfaehiges Grundverstaendnis
knowledgeDomains.description: Grundlagen technischer Energieumwandlung zu elektrischer Leistung, Leistungs- und Energiebilanzen, Wirkungsgrad, Erzeugungsprofil, Verfuegbarkeit und Systemgrenzen. Einzelne Erzeugungstechnologien werden als Anwendungen dieses Grundverstaendnisses behandelt.

rules: UNL:NOX:power-generation is a NOXIA-local unlock identity, not a canonical KnowledgeDomain or LearningModule ID.
PATH:SSF:NOX-POWER-GENERATION-0001 is an SSF-local path identity implementing ENG-L1-000001; it is not a replacement canonical LearningModule ID.
KG owns the canonical domain, concepts, learning-module identity and mapping; SSF owns didactic implementation; NOXIA owns unlock behavior and game integration.
The foundation module must teach technology-independent generation principles before technology-specific applications.
Solar PV, generator principles, storage/grid coupling and redundancy are applications of the foundation contract and must not be generalized into universal properties of every generation technology.
